name: Two-Toned Hair
body:
Your hair has a vibrant streak of a second color running through it, representing minor access to a second source of magic.

Prerequisite(s): Magical Hair.

Benefit(s): Select a second color from the list in the Magical Hair feat, which must be different from the color you took when you selected that feat. You may choose a single spell-like ability from those listed for that color, which you can use once per day. This spell-like ability has the same restrictions and limitations as those gained from Magical Hair, and its save DC (if any) is calculated with the same mental ability score that you chose for that feat.
